title: feat(platform-objects): built-in sys_task and sys_note objects
body:
Fixes #36942

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：每个环境都会自带「任务」「备忘」两个对象（分配给我的、我创建的、全部看板；我的备忘、全部备忘），任何应用都能把它们放进菜单；这一版还在草稿，菜单文字的多语言和普通成员的默认使用权限还没接上。
- 为什么做：起步应用专题的第一步，平台自带任务和备忘，权限各自独立，不挂到其它记录。
- 出错会怎样：只新增两个对象，不改任何已有记录；有问题可以整体撤回。
- 要你做的：定一件事——普通成员是否默认就能新建、查看、修改任务和备忘（目前只有管理员和另行授权的人能用）。

## What changes

- `packages/platform-objects/src/work/` (new): `sys_task` and `sys_note`, ordinary customizable objects (no `isSystem`, attachments on, comment feed left on).
  - `sys_task`: `title` (required), `description` (rich text), `status` (`todo` / `in_progress` / `done`, default `todo`), `due_at`, `assignee_id` (user, default `current_user`), `completed_at` (read-only), and a declared `owner_id`.
  - `sys_note`: optional `title`, rich-text `body`, a read-only `heading` (the title, or the body's first line when the title is empty) that is the object's `nameField`, and a declared `owner_id`.
  - Default list views: tasks `assigned_to_me` (assignee is me, status not done, by due time), `created_by_me`, `all` (kanban by status); notes `mine`, `all`.
- Sharing, the object's own only: `sharingModel: 'private'` over the declared `owner_id` (a `sys_*` object never gets the injected one; the security plugin stamps it with the creator), plus one declared sharing rule `sys_task_assignee` — the existing record-relative `field` recipient naming `assignee_id`, access `edit`. Nothing links to, grants or derives access from another record.
- `completed_at` and `heading` are kept by before-write hooks (`work/hooks.ts`), the platform's existing mechanism for a read-only column a server owns (the `examples/app-todo` completion-stamp precedent). They assign the platform value over the writer's, because the engine's create-side read-only strip leaves a `sys_*` object to its own guards.
- `PlatformObjectsPlugin` registers both objects and the sharing rule on a manifest of their own (`com.objectstack.platform-objects.work`, project database, no `defaultDatasource`) and installs the hooks in `start()`. A refused registration is logged at `warn` instead of being swallowed with the infrastructure manifests' "no manifest service" catch.

## Tests

- `packages/platform-objects/src/work/work-objects.test.ts` (new, 23 cases): declarations parse and carry exactly the card's fields; no link to another record; own sharing; the default views; the sharing rule parses and names a declared user field; the completion stamp (created done or open, into done, out of done, unrelated edit, done to done, predicate update); the note heading (title, first line of HTML and Markdown bodies, empty, forged client value, update reading the snapshot, length cap); the hook install and the `ctx.input` envelope; plugin `init` / `start` registration and the loud refusal.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-object-references.test.ts`: the item-6 pin — an app that declares neither object puts both in its navigation; `defineStack` accepts it and `validateObjectReferences` reports nothing. **Red on this head, by design of the gap below.**

## Acceptance notes

**This PR is a draft with four named gaps. The work they need sits outside the claim's file surface, and the permission classifier refused the first such edit, so nothing outside the surface was written.**

1. **Platform object registry (`packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-object-names.ts`).** Adding `sys_note` and `sys_task` to `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE['platform-objects']` is required by the registry's own maintenance contract. Without it two tests are red on this head:
   - `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-object-names.test.ts` › "registers exactly the objects each package declares" (the `repo` vitest project, Test Core): expected list lacks `sys_note`, `sys_task`.
   - the item-6 lint pin above: four `object-reference-unregistered-platform` warnings (`requiresObject` and `objectName` on each entry), and nothing else.
2. **Translations.** The object bundles are generated from `packages/platform-objects/scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts`, which has to import `SysTask` and `SysNote` before `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` can emit their keys. Hand-adding keys to the generated bundles would be drift. Object labels for the hand-written locale values: zh-CN 任务 / 备忘, zh-Hant 任務 / 備忘, ja-JP タスク / メモ, ko 작업 / 메모, es-ES Tarea / Nota, fr Tâche / Note, de Aufgabe / Notiz, pt-BR Tarefa / Nota, ru Задача / Заметка, ar مهمة / ملاحظة.
3. **Real-runtime acceptance tests.** "registers in a fresh runtime", "completed_at end to end" and "a second user without a share cannot read" need ObjectQL, the security plugin and the sharing plugin booted together. `platform-objects` cannot host that test (ObjectQL depends on it; the reverse import is a cycle turbo rejects). The natural home is `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/`, beside `operator-id-write-gate-33928.test.ts`, which boots that exact composition over better-sqlite3.

4. **Tenancy census.** `check:platform-object-tenancy-census` reports the derived artefact `scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.json` out of date (`+ sys_note`, `+ sys_task`, registered 108 → 110). The repair is its generator, `node scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.mjs --write`.

**Navigation entries need `requiresObject`.** Measured: `defineStack` refuses `{ type: 'object', objectName: 'sys_task' }` in an app that does not declare `sys_task` ("App 'starter' navigation references object 'sys_task' which is not defined in objects."), and accepts it with `requiresObject: 'sys_task'` beside it. The starter app (#36944) has to spell the gate, or `defineStack` has to learn the registry.

**Member access.** `member_default` names no business object (explicit allow only), so an ordinary member has no object permission on `sys_task` / `sys_note` until a permission set grants it. Administrators reach both through their wildcard sets. Whether the platform baseline should grant them is a security-baseline decision, raised in the report, not made here.

Also noted, not changed: `sys_*` objects get no recycle bin (ADR-0148), are not AI-readable unless they opt in with `aiReadable`, and are skipped by the user-deactivation "assigned work" census.

## Verification

Read first:
1. `packages/platform-objects/src/work/hooks.ts` › `stampTaskCompletion`: the insert branch assigns over the client value; the update branch acts only when `status` is in the write.
2. `packages/platform-objects/src/plugin.ts` › `init`: the separate work-manifest registration and its `warn`.
3. `packages/platform-objects/src/work/sharing-rules.ts`: the assignee rule (`field` recipient, `edit`).
